title: My Morning Routine
english_sentences: I wake up at seven o'clock.
I brush my teeth and wash my face.
Then I eat breakfast with my family.
chinese_sentences: 然後和家人一起吃早餐。

title: At the Library
english_sentences: I go to the library every weekend.
I like to read English storybooks.
Sometimes I listen to audiobooks too.
chinese_sentences: 我每個週末都會去圖書館。
有時候我也會聽有聲書。
